prompts.name: recorder
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: subtle illustrated background for one small feature card on a multilingual digital roadbook website.
Style: restrained premium technical still-life, shallow isometric relief on matte charcoal, fine topographic contours, precise geometry, not a screenshot or a flat app icon. Landscape 3:2 composition.
Palette: almost-black charcoal #101313, graphite grey, a few warm white details, very restrained burnt-orange #ff7a1a highlights. Low-key soft lighting, tactile matte materials, no neon bloom.
Composition: subject grouped in the upper/right two thirds. Left third and bottom quarter fade naturally into plain charcoal negative space for real HTML content placed later.
ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINTS: no text, no letters, no numbers, no typography, no logos, no watermarks, no labels, no words on screens or paper; no vehicle, no people, no photographs of outdoor adventures. No fake UI controls or promises of product features. A conceptual editorial illustration of the described real tool, not a screen capture.
Subject: LIVE GPS ROUTE RECORDING. A fine orange breadcrumb track crosses a dark embossed contour map, ending in one small location bead surrounded by a circular recording pulse. Along the recorded section are two small graphic pins for a photo and an audio waveform. Communicate capture of a travelled route and geotagged notes, no satellite, no navigation arrow ahead of the route.

prompts.name: convoy
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one supporting wide editorial photograph for a digital-roadbook 4x4/overlanding landing page, 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: an authentic small overland convoy in an alpine valley, restrained charcoal, orange and natural mountain greens.
Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for the supplied RDBK brand emblem, not an edit target. Keep its mountain/compass/tire identity; use it once as a realistic medium-size door decal on the nearest vehicle. Do not redesign the emblem.
Scene: three different unbranded rugged 4x4 vehicles parked safely single file beside a winding established gravel mountain pass. Nearest is a charcoal expedition wagon with a modest orange recovery board and the referenced emblem on the door; a muted sand offroader and another charcoal vehicle further back. Pine forest, distant jagged peaks, calm overcast morning, light trail dust, subtle wear on tires.
Composition: wide documentary frame, cars in lower/right half with generous mountain landscape, believable scale and natural 35mm lens. No spectacle, no dangerous driving, no staged advertising shine.
Constraints: no added text, slogans, headings, captions, readable plates, road-sign words, vehicle maker badges or watermarks. The ONLY lettering allowed is what is already intrinsic to the supplied RDBK emblem. No other words or numbers anywhere. Website copy will be real multilingual HTML. Natural photography, not a poster, not a UI mockup, no collage.
